'''Craig Teppert Kiss the Goofball Hidden Base''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Craig Teppert]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-18998">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18998 Kiss the Goofball Hidden Base], DeckTech (Craig "Mr.Goofball" Teppert, 19 September 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/18998/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/18998/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261017021717/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18998/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Craig Teppert]]
* '''Published:''' 19 September 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Kiss the Goofball Hidden Base''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCor HB Teppert LS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits A Hidden Base System (varies), Kiffex (Jabba's Palace): no GEMP blueprint)
* '''Strategy:''' Basically the deck tries to flip the objective as soon as possible, while setting the ships up to drain at Kessel, Naboo, and Kiffex. I am a New player, so any advice would be appreciated.

== Original post ==

'''Kiss the Goofball Hidden Base'''
* '''Author:''' Craig "Mr.Goofball" Teppert
* '''Published:''' September 19, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' Basically the deck tries to flip the objective as soon as possible, while setting the ships up to drain at Kessel, Naboo, and Kiffex. I am a New player, so any advice would be appreciated.

=== Strategy ===

As I stated in the Intro, I try to flip and drain at Kessel, Kiffix and Naboo. The reason there are so many planets in here is I see way to many security precautions, and the greater number help ease the loss when they find my base.  Corran Horn is in because I needed a ability 4 non Skywalker pilot to go against Maul in his ship, Especially against Hunt Down.  This deck can hold it's own against space decks, be Tie or Star Destroyers due to the variety of weapons.  The deck I am having the most problems with is Dark side Senate. Any suggestion to improve this would be great.
